agent_instructions.proposition: For OpenTelemetry Java agent 2.x, the default OTLP protocol is `http/protobuf`, not `grpc`.

supported_by.quote: versions 2.0+ of the Java agent and OpenTelemetry Spring Boot starter use http/protobuf as the default protocol, not grpc

agent_instructions.proposition: If both `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` and a `service.name` entry in `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` are present, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` takes precedence, so the effective service name is the value of `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`.

supported_by.quote: If service.name is also provided in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, then OTEL_SERVICE_NAME takes precedence.

agent_instructions.proposition: With the corresponding SDK environment variables unset, the trace exporter defaults to `otlp`, the propagators default to `tracecontext,baggage`, and the trace sampler defaults to `parentbased_always_on`.

supported_by.quote: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER Trace exporter to be used otlp
OTEL_PROPAGATORS Propagators to be used as a comma-separated list tracecontext,baggage
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER Sampler to be used for traces parentbased_always_on

agent_instructions.proposition: An empty environment-variable value is interpreted in the same way as an unset variable.

supported_by.quote: The SDK MUST interpret an empty value of an environment variable the same way as when the variable is unset.
